verdict.rationale: v0 provides its own Platform API and an official SDK. The docs say the API gives "programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities" for your own workflows, and the SDK authenticates through a V0_API_KEY environment variable, so it can be driven headlessly from scripts. Running v0 inside a CI pipeline is only implied. The GitHub CI features are a different thing: they show CI status for v0 branches and offer UI-driven "Fix CI" actions, rather than letting v0 run within CI. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or headless runner, explicit CI pipeline usage docs or examples (e.g. a GitHub Action), and independent hands-on corroboration of automated or CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The v0 API gives you programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities, letting you integrate v0's AI-powered code generation, chat interface, project management, and deployment features into your own applications and workflows.
Set V0_API_KEY, or deploy server-side code on Vercel with OIDC enabled, then use the default client.
